description: Renovate configuration for stellabill-backend. Minor/patch Go module bumps are auto-merged after CI passes (stabilityDays: 3). Major bumps require manual review. OTel packages are grouped to reduce PR churn.

packageRules.description: Group all OpenTelemetry packages into a single PR to reduce churn (they release in lock-step).
Auto-merge minor and patch Go module updates once CI passes and the version has been stable for stabilityDays.
Major Go module bumps require manual review — no automerge, add a review label.
Group semver-major updates for the same package together so reviewers see the full blast-radius in one PR.
Keep the Go toolchain directive itself as a separate PR for explicit review.
GitHub Actions: auto-merge patch/minor, require review for major.
GitHub Actions major version bumps need manual review.
